briefdescription.para: XPmApuCore_IsValidCoreInLockstep() - Check if APU core is valid in lockstep mode.

detaileddescription.para:
DeviceId
Device ID of the APU core
In lockstep mode for Versal Net, each APU cluster has 4 cores. Only cores 0 and 2 are valid in lockstep mode; cores 1 and 3 are invalid and should not be allowed to wake up or power down.
Return: XST_SUCCESS if core is valid, XST_INVALID_PARAM if core is invalid in lockstep mode, XST_FAILURE if operation mode cannot be determined
